description: The skins.json file is the core metadata file that defines all skins within a skin pack.

serialize_name.description: The unique identifier used for serialization and as the base for localization keys

localization_name.description: The localization key identifier that maps to the skin pack's display name

skins.description: An array of skin objects defining individual skins in the pack

skin.description: An individual skin definition within a skin pack.

localization_name.description: The localization key for this individual skin's display name

geometry.description: The player model geometry this skin applies to

texture.description: The filename of the PNG texture file
